question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, which Angel Funds are required to mandatorily carry out annual PPM audit, and from which financial year?

answer.text: All Angel Funds, from FY 2023-24 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 50 crore, from FY 2024-25 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 100 crore, from FY 2025-26 onwards
Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 500 crore, from FY 2026-27 onwards

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.2, Angel Funds with total investments (at cost) exceeding INR 100 crore are required to mandatorily carry out an annual audit of compliance with the terms of the PPM from FY 2025-26 onwards, in line with the SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025. The Trap: INR 50 crore and INR 500 crore are not the prescribed thresholds. FY 2023-24 and FY 2026-27 are wrong effective years — the threshold-based audit obligation begins in FY 2025-26. Note: Three elements must be remembered together: it is an Angel-Fund-specific rule, the threshold is INR 100 crore measured at cost, and the start year is FY 2025-26 per the September 10, 2025 SEBI circular.
